items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Joe Marsala, he gave Zutty some money and told Zutty he wanted him to play the jam session on Sunday afternoon. And that was Zutty's first gig in New York... He paid Zutty thirty-five dollars

ctx.x: And he didn't have any trouble with them. They understood it because he had reported to the Company... He had almost paid for the car but he didn't have any money and Mezz didn't have any money. And we couldn't ask [unintelligible 4)] still about seven hundred dollars. And still it was a brand new '36 Ford and fancy. All chrome all the way around. Oh yes, and so we used Mezz's car because Mezz had a car. And that's when Zuddy ......
Joe Marsala was the cause of me getting my first payment on the car. It was $27.50 a month.
